Name: Harvey Apologizes
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds a letter from Harvey if you made a certain decision during his 2 hearts events, and a following event between him and Georges. As a doctor, Harvey wants to do his best, and sometimes this means learning and changing !


Note : this mod doesn't change the vanilla event in any way. The friendship loss in the vanilla event stay unchanged. The reason is that even if Harvey is able to apologize and try to do better, he was still disappointed that you didn't support him.
The goal of my mod isn't to remove the importance of the choice you make, but rather expands a bit of how Harvey could reflect on the situation.

Includes a french version.

Thanks to Trunip190, MJA1981 and the SDV discord for help, debugging and fixing some sentences.
